logic: The administration's year overview that GET /api/admin/donations/overview[?year=] answers (AdminOverviewService over the real queries, then YearOverview.compile): input.year is the requested year or null; the expected value is the answer as sent. The rows hold only the columns the computation reads: a runner fills every other column with any valid value. A donor is a donor_record row (registeredAt and erasedAt instants); a payment a bank_payment row (bookedOn, amountMinor, and unpairedByAdminAt, the instant an administrator unpaired it or null); a donation a donation row of a donor, with the payment it was paired from (a bank transfer) or none (MANUAL), status RECEIVED or REFUNDED and purpose GENERAL or ACCOUNT_VERIFICATION. A payment no donation points to is unpaired. now is the server clock; the foundation's calendar is Prague's. Since 2.20b input.chunks holds the rows of the administration's device copy the browser computes the same overview from (donations/payments:<yyyy-mm>, donations/donations:<yyyy-mm> and donations/donor-records:<yyyy-mm>, keyed <part>/<chunk id> as the device stores them, ids aliased as CaseRows names them): the backend runner checks that the copy holds exactly these chunks, and the browser compiles the expected overview and every offered year from them for the Prague day of now.
